map.：室外焓 h_w≈81.8、室内 h_n≈52.8 kJ/kg；全热 Q = 2: : Outdoor enthalpy h_w is about 81.8 and indoor h_n about 52.8 kJ/kg; total heat Q = 2000 x 1.2 x (81.8 - 52.8)/3600, about 19.3 kW, with sensible heat accounting for about 60%.
map.：全热回收效率 60% 时，新风负荷由 19.3 降到约 7.7 kW，主机与运: : With 60% total heat recovery efficiency, the fresh air load drops from 19.3 to about 7.7 kW, noticeably reducing the main unit size and running cost.
map.送风量与风速设计计算器: Air supply volume and velocity design calculator
map.焓差怎么取？: How to obtain the enthalpy difference?
map.由室内外温湿度查湿空气焓湿图得 h(kJ/kg)，乘新风量×密度÷3600 得: From indoor and outdoor temperature and humidity, read the moist-air psychrometric chart to get h (kJ/kg), then multiply by fresh air rate x density / 3600 to get kW.
map.为什么显热潜热分开？: Why separate sensible and latent heat?
map.显热处理温度、潜热处理湿度，机组再热与除湿能力按两者分配，分开才选得准。: Sensible heat handles temperature and latent heat handles humidity; the unit's reheat and dehumidification capacities are allocated between the two, so separating them is the only way to select accurately.
